title: [Mac/PC] Super Retro Hockey - I’ve spent 5 years making Super Retro Hockey and after countless iterations, I finally have a teaser trailer!
author: dailyapplecrisp
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on **Super Retro Hockey** for about 5 years now, through countless iterations, redesigns, and probably more late nights than I'd like to admit!

I grew up playing **NHL '95 with my brother**, and those old-school hockey games have always had a special place in my heart. But as much as I loved the gameplay, I was also obsessed with the franchise and management modes in sports games. Building a team, developing players, making trades, and creating your own little sports universe was always just as fun to me as actually playing the games.

I was heavily inspired by games like the original **NHL94, Retro Bowl, Bitball, and Bang Average Football (Soccer)**, which I think do a fantastic job of combining accessible, arcade-style gameplay with surprisingly deep management systems.

I actually started this project during the pandemic as an iOS game built with SpriteKit. Eventually, I decided to rebuild/port everything over to **Godot** (because, well, SpriteKit...), and the project has evolved considerably since then.

I'm a software engineer by trade, but I've always loved world-building and creating little universes. This has been my creative outlet for years. I've made most of the pixel art and assets myself, with some help from talented artists on Fiverr along the way. I did a lot of the porting to Godot using AI and also the later stages of the game mostly vibe coded with a lot of guidance/help with the architecture from yours truly. Anyway, let me know what y'all think. Thanks so much!!
